Ordered 4 dishes + 1 soup and came to about 1100Baht. Wanted Omelette Crab but out of stock. So we ordered Stinky Beans + Prawns, Fried pork with brown sauce, Young Coconut shoots + prawns, Glass Noodles with eggs and prawns, and Signature White Tom Yum Seafood. Everything was so good. Highly recommended. Will definitely come back again.

author: Sharon Soh
review_text: It was just behind our hotel so was very lucky to have such a high quality restaurant nearby. Boss was friendly and the place has very nice interiors. Above all food was perfect. Do reserve before visiting to avoid disappointment...or finish your meal before 6pm if you can come early. I will be back.

author: Chee Chin Cheng
review_text: Extremely overpriced. Food is just average. Not worth the price.  There are better authentic thai food at other places. The restaurant is quite small . 5 of us ordered 2 Appetizer and 2 main dishes and it cost us 1730 baht. Only the Appetizer set is good and the sauce is very nice and special. The white tom yam was a disappointment. Not recommended to eat at this place.

author: Iced Latte
review_text: I was there with 7 pax (4 elderly, 1 teenager). Food was alright, wasn't extraordinary. Service was extraordinarily rude though. We ordered their 3 in 1 appetiser and ended up with 4 dishes (fish, omelet, stir fry vege and stir fry tofu). We only wanted to go with 3 dishes but the waitress almost had her jaw dropped and did not want to leave our table and demanded that we proceed with the 4th dish. Two waitresses were unhappy, told us we cant add on orders later cause they have tooo many customers and quickly kept the menu. So if you are not a big eater, dont bother dining here. The restaurant should perhaps put up a minimum spend per table :)

author: Supakij Khomvilai
review_text: I stop by to get famous snack, Caramel Almond Stick and Ar Lua from Chalom shop in front of the restaurant. It's really good taste. You have to try it. Not so sweet and good ingredients they choose for the snack. You will love it ! Recommended.

author: mark phea
review_text: only 5 star rating will represent everything, nothing much can say so..

author: Will Tan
review_text: Nice food, fried rice is very flavorful,  wanton noodle also quite good, fish ball tasted like from SGP in a good way. many tourists driving from Malaysia will stop here for breakfast.

author: Debbie Voon
review_text: The food is good. The fried crab thingy is really good. Enjoyed the wantan noodles too. The drinks were a little strong in color but taste is fine.

author: Cher Ong
review_text: A place that specialises in egg noodles 🍜 & various types of meat. The roast duck & roast pork are delicious. The roast pork has a very crispy & fragrant skin. The ratio of the meat is just nice, not too oily. The crab meat roll is quite nice, but a bit greasy. Ordered the 5 piece set for 2 pax, a bit too much. The egg noodle tastes average. Service is very bad. They have plenty of staff, but none of them are attentive. No smile on their faces & rude attitude.

author: Victor Khoo
review_text: Not a bad place for a hearty bowl of egg noodle soup with mixed meats, 2 prawn dumplings and a fish ball. This is the first time I’ve been here. Since I wasn’t sure which roast meat to have, I went for a little bit of each so I can sample and taste each of them. Crispy roast pork, bbq pork and roast duck. It turns out my favorite was the prawn dumplings.

author: Billy Kok
review_text:
Another recommended restaurant to visit for noodles and rice. Good Thai Chinese food. Reasonable prices. Menu with English and wait staff with knowledge of Chinese dialects.

Fish balls, veggies, sui-kau, roasted duck, crab meat balls (not in menu) and must have their 'leong-fun' ice.

author: Alexander Wong
review_text: Modern chinese restaurant serving their signature wanton noodles, crab meat balls and roast pork. The roast pork has a crispy outer layer with melting fats in the middle. Doesn't have that porky smell and taste very delightful. The crab meat ball for me was alright but has a strong crab smell that I'm unaccustomed to. Otherwise the fish ball and wanton noodle clean flavours and bright ambiance is acceptable.

author: K M
review_text:
What's great?
1) Grass jelly. This is more firm, yummy!
2) Crab roll
3) Prawn dumpling
4) Roast meat platter

What to improve?
Nothing. Maybe bundle some discount with adjacent desert shop?

Visit again?
Yes!

author: Mrs Chew
review_text: I had the wanton noodle soup with roast pork. The noodle is nice and the soup is good. I personally recommend the deep fried crab meat roll, it very flavourful coupled with the Thai chilli sauce.

author: Boonwei Koh
review_text:
Overrated food, no chilli sauce for the meat and the orange juice is very stingy portion.
Wanton noodle taste is below average.

author: Vling Chong
review_text:
There are many branch here, this branch is open most early than others.
Recommend by friend is must eat in Hatyai.
It is delicious enough especially their fried crab ball , Thai milk tea is must also.
Love all the food here, fast service and food be reserve with fast and hot .
Will visit here again next time come back travel to Hatyai 😀

author: Kh Ong
review_text: crispy roast pork.. melts in your mouth.. one of the best i have tried in my life.. crab meat  dumplings, beef tripe noodles great. wanton dumplings equally good.. and dont forget to try the dessert french toast.. a must visit place. price also very reasonable

author: Thian Boon Seng
review_text: One of the best place to have a breakfast in hatyai. Clean, air conditions and good services

author: 00Y
review_text: This spot serves arguably the best wanton noodles in town—springy noodles, tender duck, and crispy siew yuk (no greasy mess!). Their Thai tea is divine, and the mango sticky rice next door (Ken Phu Phang) is the perfect finale. Just two caveats: Parking is tricky, and service can be hit-or-miss.

author: Su Sie Yap
review_text: Popular place for local and tourist.  Roasted pork if u like half fat half meat is good as not too salty.  Char siew soft, good.  Duck meat was tender and deep fried crab meat roll was yummy.  Wantan noodles considered good.  They even have the noodles that you can buy to take back to cook.  Don't have vegetable option, only Kai Lan was available during our visit.  Cold milk tea recommended.  Worth eating here as overall service good.

author: Oscar Tan
review_text: Everything here tastes so good! The restaurant is air-conditioned with a nice vibe as they play a lot of early 2000s classics, and the staffs were mostly friendly. Only thing I can nitpick is that the Pandan Toast was kinda expensive as it costs 119฿. Definitely would return the next time.

author: Ervin Lau
review_text: Delicious shrimp wan ton. Love the crabmeat ball, very juicy. Nice place for brunch. Be ready to have some patient here.

author: Andrew Chan (www.roadtrippers.asia)
review_text: Nice comfortable aircond seating, spacious and clean .. food is good, but I wanted roasted duck, and they were out of it. Shrimp wanton is very nice. Portion is quite generous, and the price is fair. My meal was 155b. Their longan drink is nice too.

author: C T
review_text:
I visited the restaurant around 1 pm on a Tuesday and was delighted to find ample seating available. The noodles were wonderfully tender, reminiscent of the authentic Hong Kong style, and the char siew meat was a particular highlight, absolutely delicious!

The Thai milk tea was a delightful accompaniment, offering a great balance of flavors. Moreover, the restaurant’s prompt service was impressive, ensuring a swift dining experience. The comfortable ambiance added to the overall enjoyment of the meal. A highly recommended spot

author: Alice Woo
review_text: We wanted to try some Wanton Noodles and stopped by Nanyuan Noodle Restaurant for lunch. We ordered a few bowls of Egg Noodle with Shrimp Wanton and Roast Pork, Steam Rice with Roast Pork, Steam Rice with Roast Duck (comes with pickled ginger, half hard boiled egg and cucumber slices), Steam Rice with Roast Pork & Bbq Pork and Egg Noodle with Roast Duck, Roast Pork, Bbq Pork, Shrimp Wanton & Fishball. Both the noodles and rice dishes tasted delicious! The noodles were chewy and the meats were cooked to perfection and tasted so flavourful. They also have dimsum but we only ordered the Steamed Taro Buns, which were a bit too sweet for us. Overall, lunch was delicious and satisfying!

author: YEW KEEN LIM
review_text:
A comfortable shop with several food supply, got noodle, got rice, got some simple Dim Sum.

Tea and juice is very good experience here and staff are friendly, shop owner also very well taking care

Food is good taste and meet the Asia style. Price is reasonable and is worth.

The shop is expanding, next time will have more seat. Hehe

restaurant: จำเนียร Jamnien ( Coffee & Dine )
author: C J
review_text:
The tom yum soup was absolutely bursting with flavor—spicy, tangy, and aromatic all at once. You could really taste the lemongrass, lime leaves, and galangal, giving it that signature Thai kick. The broth had just the right balance of heat and sourness, with meatballs and fresh mushrooms soaking up all the goodness. It was comforting, bold, and totally satisfying—each spoonful warmed me up and made me want more!

The iced Americano Thai Tea was appropriately sweet, creamy, and super refreshing—exactly what I needed to cool down after the spicy soup. It had that rich, deep tea flavor with a hint of spice, perfectly balanced by the creamy condensed milk. Served over ice, it was smooth, flavorful, and honestly kind of addictive.

The cafe does not have air conditioning. So maybe a little bit hot. But overall it is a great spot to enjoy local tomyam and thai tea!

restaurant: จำเนียร Jamnien ( Coffee & Dine )
author: Ng Kah Yan
review_text: I cannot recommend this place enough! While the food was delicious, the staff truly made the experience memorable. Our server was so kind and helpful, she purposely walked out from the bar table, crossed over the road to get a tuk-tuk for us after we had our lunch there. It's rare to find service this genuinely warm. We will absolutely be back!

restaurant: จำเนียร Jamnien ( Coffee & Dine )
author: Duangsamorn Songmuang
review_text: Delicious A la carte .slow cooking.service is ok.chill atmosphere .

restaurant: จำเนียร Jamnien ( Coffee & Dine )
author: Siam Srisuwan
review_text: It's a vintage-style cafe where every angle you take a photo is beautiful. The single-dish meals are also delicious.

restaurant: จำเนียร Jamnien ( Coffee & Dine )
author: laksanan klubtublung
review_text: The food is delicious and the portions are reasonable. It's not hard to find the restaurant.

restaurant: จำเนียร Jamnien ( Coffee & Dine )
author: Amie Yg
review_text: The food is delicious and the prices are reasonable. The menu has Thai and English options and there are many choices. I was pleasantly surprised by this restaurant.

restaurant: จำเนียร Jamnien ( Coffee & Dine )
author: PRU SE
review_text:
Restaurant and cafe
Delicious food, a variety of drinks to choose from, coffee, tea, fruit juice, soda
Mid-range to high prices, but the food and ingredients used with the taste are worth the price
The atmosphere of the shop is loft + vintage, sit and eat, sip coffee, chill out. You have to find parking on the side of the road, but it's not difficult because there aren't many cars on this road.

restaurant: จำเนียร Jamnien ( Coffee & Dine )
author: Jutamas S (Umez)
review_text: The shop has a nice atmosphere, the food is very delicious, and the coffee is quite good. However, the tables are a bit small, making it difficult for diners to place their plates.

restaurant: จำเนียร Jamnien ( Coffee & Dine )
author: Rose K
review_text: All the food is delicious. I really like the soft pork curry rice. Today I ate fried rice with rice noodles. It's exactly like the one I used to eat when I was a kid.

restaurant: จำเนียร Jamnien ( Coffee & Dine )
author: Than Pawannanwanitch
review_text:
Hong Kong style pork rice - The best!
Excellent medium roast Americano
10 out of 10

restaurant: จำเนียร Jamnien ( Coffee & Dine )
author: Araya S
review_text: Ordered through Grab. Price and quantity of food are not appropriate for the portion. Picture is not as shown. Disappointed. Ordered pork dumplings with pickled plums. Thought it was a pig spirit. Expensive compared to quantity.

restaurant: จำเนียร Jamnien ( Coffee & Dine )
author: Pizsanupong Sangkaeo
review_text: Delicious food, friendly service, good atmosphere, suitable for social gatherings.

restaurant: จำเนียร Jamnien ( Coffee & Dine )
author: Palanthorn Loomcharoen
review_text: Delicious food, relaxed atmosphere, and live music at night.

restaurant: จำเนียร Jamnien ( Coffee & Dine )
author: B
review_text: The atmosphere reminds me of my grandmother's house. The food is delicious and the coffee tastes good.

restaurant: จำเนียร Jamnien ( Coffee & Dine )
author: จิรภา หลีมานัน
review_text: The Thai tea is delicious. The shop is beautiful and great for taking photos. The price of the drinks is not too high.

restaurant: จำเนียร Jamnien ( Coffee & Dine )
author: เอียด มะนาวหวาน
review_text: The atmosphere is chill, the food is affordable, and the music is great.

restaurant: จำเนียร Jamnien ( Coffee & Dine )
author: iingz TD
review_text: There are a lot of mosquitoes in the evening, so food comes out slowly.

restaurant: จำเนียร Jamnien ( Coffee & Dine )
author: อภินันท์ รุจิระกรกุล
review_text: Sit back and relax, focus on conversation, not snacks. Comfortable, but there's no backrest. Older people should consider it.

restaurant: จำเนียร Jamnien ( Coffee & Dine )
author: MaiAek agri
review_text: Great and chill atmosphere, delicious food, friendly staff and prices.

restaurant: จำเนียร Jamnien ( Coffee & Dine )
author: แอ๊ด อิน
review_text: I like the decoration of the shop, it is nice and chill. The coffee is nice. The staff are very knowledgeable about coffee.

author: Notorious
review_text: A cozy little coffee shop with a warm, classic home interior that serves a lovely cup of coffee along with other beverages and desserts. It’s not just a spot to unwind — you can also browse through books or enjoy some board games while you’re here. The service is friendly, the atmosphere calm and welcoming, and there’s even a resident cat at the back waiting to play with you 🐱

author: S C
review_text: A charming little cafe that serves great coffee and fresh baked items. Love the decor and staff is friendly.  We had their cappuccino,  dirty latte,  cinnamon bun and banana bread , all better than expectations.

author: Winnn
review_text: To be honest, the drinks here aren’t that impressive, even though the barista and coffee machine look really professional... 😮‍💨 But the environment and setup are great for taking nice photos 📸. So if you’re coming mainly for the drinks, you might want to consider another café. But if you’re here for the vibe and photo spots, it’s a good pick... They even stick a paper "Photo Spots" on some of the chair 🤣

author: Nitikorn Kaewchoo
review_text: This place always makes me feel good every time I come by — whether it's the cozy atmosphere, the friendly chats with the staff, or the warm, down-to-earth vibe from the owner. There's a great selection of coffee to match any taste, and the menu has some real standouts, especially the delicious desserts. Everything just feels right here. It's my favorite spot, and it always will be.

author: SE Teoh
review_text:
went this cafe during weekday, lesser crowds and better experience.
If you come here not sure what to order, I’ll definitely tell you is their Dirty coffee!
I’m a non coffee lover but gt impressed by their Dirty coffee!❤️ every time come Hatyai must visit this cafe!

author: James
review_text: Coffee and carrot cake here are so nice. The atmosphere is really cool as well. Loved it.

author: Jia Yin
review_text: Service is not good. The owner got attitude issue. Rude to paying customers for no valid reason. Bought 4 coffees, about to leave and family wanted to use the bathroom, then started nagging us. The experience was not worth the mediocre coffee. she can ask us nicely but she choose the offensive way, we didnt make noise we just sitting there chilling. she owe us a apologies.

author: Poh Zhi Nan
review_text:
Amazing coffee place in Hatyai! Highly recommend the coffee here which was full-bodied and had the right amount of sweetness and bitterness. I ordered the iced caramel macchiato and there was caramel jelly as well which enhanced the texture and flavour. The tiramisu was also really yummy!

A lot of Malaysians and locals come here, and as a Singaporean, I can certify this place is worth a visit for your coffee fix. There’s also a cat in the house which made my morning. The staff are friendly as well! Will be more than happy to come back and try other drinks on the menu!

author: Min Khant Zaw
review_text: Tiramisu tastes pretty good but their coffee is pretty mediocre. Staffs are quite helpful and nice. However, the atmosphere of this cafe is not that great compared to other cafes in town.

author: I
review_text: Visited on a Monday afternoon. My friend had the medium roast iced americano and I had the light roast tiramisu blend iced americano. I loved my coffee, smooth with a rich aroma. The banana cake was also delicious, not too sweet. They also have a big cute orange cat!

author: ItsJaycee Zhuang
review_text:
Good and nice cafe! Selling coffees and some traditional Thai cakes that are affordable as well! Barista is really friendly that she even shared her experiences and her stories on her coffees!

Please come to try the dirty! It would amaze you!

author: Khoo Jolyn
review_text: A quaint little cafe with a homey feeling. Staff is friendly and helpful and can speak English which helps when we place orders. Types of cakes sold changes everyday. On our visit we had Tiramisu. Drinks are special too and prices are very reasonable.

author: Kanana Kaewsomboon
review_text: This cafe is decorated in a retro style. It might not look very appealing from the outside, but the atmosphere inside is cozy, and all the drinks we ordered were excellent—iced latte, dirty coffee, and iced honey lemon coffee. I’m sure I’ll visit again the next time I’m in Hat Yai.

author: edmund goh
review_text:
Little cosy cafe.
Coffee is good and recommended.
We took the Yuzu americano and 'big dirty' latte and we were not disappointed.
The cookie was superb, too.

Price is midrange .

Not many seats are available, esp if you are a big group.

author: Khansa Gian
review_text: I went there because of the good reviews, and the rating speaks for itself. The place has a cool and calming ambience, the playlist was so good I could hear some of my favorites (CAS, Hozier). Loved their mint chocolate, and the coffee was so smooth I would come back for more. The staff and owner were so kind and friendly to their customers, I had a quick chat before I left just to share what I thought about the place. Hope the business is good so they can stay open to spread the goodness.

author: Wai Kit Lim
review_text: Very good atmosphere, the cafe is using old school design theme which is very pleasant to hang out with friends and family. Must give a try to their pastry/cake !

author: Raymond Wu
review_text: Love this quaint coffee place in the midst of Hatyai Town! The coffee is absolutely great. Not only that, the desserts are superb too which we didn’t expect at all! The owner is friendly and has a love to be pampered cat. Definitely will return here whenever I’m back in Hatyai.

author: art noise
review_text: nice coffee.. nice shop.. friendly owner and staff .. nice cat .. everything is nice

author: Keke Nono
review_text: Found this cafe randomly in Hatyai last weekend. The cafe is so cozy and chill. Tried their light roast Tiramisu blend and love it so much!🤍

author: Alice YJ
review_text:
Love the Dirty Coffee ☕️ of this cafe. Rainy day is an added point as it feels extremely calm looking at the raindrop, taking a sip of coffee while listening the music …
Cute cat which I believe belongs to the cafe owner…

author: Bobby Lornimitdee
review_text: A classic gem in Hat Yai! 💎 AR Restaurant serves amazing Chinese cuisine using the freshest ingredients. Must try: Deep-fried Tofu with Crab Sauce.  Other highlights: Crispy Shrimp Rolls (Hae Keun) and tender Stir-fried Squid with Celery. Their Pork Stomach with Sweet Pickled Greens is also a winner!  Only 780 THB for a feast. Big portions, great price, and 10/10 taste

author: Teng Sook Yin
review_text:
Forgot to snap photos of most of the dishes as it was late and we were very hungry. The dishes were served quite quickly. Tomyam was tasty. So was the pork knuckles and sweet and sour petai prawns. All the dishes were decent except for the shrimp roll which was lacked of shrimp taste or texture. The price was reasonable. The restaurant was packed when we arrived.

Update : We patronized this restaurant again on 15 Nov, 2025. And ordered similar dishes. So managed to snap photos of the dishes.

#Hatyai, #Chineserestaurant

author: Glen Yu
review_text:
Variety of Thai Chinese foods:

AR Restaurant in Hat Yai is a must-visit for anyone looking to experience a delicious blend of authentic Thai and Chinese cuisine. The restaurant successfully captures the essence of classic Southeast Asian dining with its charming, old-school ambiance, making you feel right at home. The friendly staff and quick service add to the welcoming atmosphere, even during peak hours.
The variety of dishes on offer is impressive, with a menu that caters to diverse tastes. Their strength lies in their ability to use fresh, high-quality ingredients, which shines through in every bite. While the restaurant may be more celebrated for its Chinese-style dishes, such as the succulent braised goose and the highly-praised pork knuckle, its Thai offerings are equally outstanding.
For a true Thai culinary adventure, don't miss the Tom Yum Talay, which is a perfect symphony of sour, spicy, and sweet flavors. The Kerabu Chicken Feet is another standout, with its delightful texture and flavorful sauce. The extensive menu also includes a variety of other popular dishes like Fried Fish Maw, Steamed Fish with Soy Sauce, and a range of vegetarian options. The prices are very reasonable, especially given the generous portion sizes, making it a great value for both locals and tourists.
While it's worth noting that some reviews mention a focus on Thai-Chinese flavors rather than the fiery heat of traditional Thai cuisine, the food is consistently praised for its quality and deliciousness. AR Restaurant is more than just a place to eat; it's a genuine culinary destination that truly lives up to its reputation for serving some of the best Thai-Chinese food in Hat Yai."

author: Pk C
review_text: A local seafood restaurant. Generally, the food here is acceptable, especially the fried fishhead, which is really enjoyable. It get really crowded during dinner time and a long queue is expected.

author: Cynthia
review_text:
The sweet and sour petai prawns were delicious — the prawns were fresh and naturally sweet!
The tom yum fish soup was on the sour side, and it came with plenty of king oyster mushrooms, which were really tasty.
The minced pork omelette had small chilies in it, so it was quite spicy — but very flavorful.
All three dishes went perfectly with rice!
We were a group of four and the total was 720 THB.
We visited in the afternoon, and the restaurant was a bit warm inside, but overall it’s a great spot for a good local meal.

author: Simple Simon
review_text: One of my favourite Chinese and Thai restaurants in Hatyai. Been here since the old  chef the father who is no longer here now. Must try fried pork leg and shrimps paste fried. Price and portion is reasonable. Now the son is running the show and can speak Chinese and English.

author: KH (Alson)
review_text: Local Thai Chinese food. Order the recommend food from the menu. Overall is good, serving food is quite fast.

author: Robin CHAN
review_text: AR is highly recommended by hotel staff for its variety and food choice.  Typical chinese style cooking with local flavours. Crab meat unfortunately wasn’t fresh.

author: See Empty
review_text:
We arrived at Ar Restaurant around 3:30pm local time, after a long travel to Hatyai. It was just a short walk from our hotel. We were famished, as we hadn't had our lunch yet. Luckily, the restaurant was practically empty when we arrived, so the food was served quickly after we placed our orders.

First up was the medium sized Seafood Tom Yum. The soup was rich and flavourful, and the spiciness and sourness was just nice. The seafood tasted great too. The medium sized portion was just right for the 4 of us.

Then came Stir Fried Asparagus with Prawns, with king oyster mushrooms in it as well. Simple yet tasty.

Up next was Spicy Petai with Squid. Squid were cooked with the petai beans, along with chillies and basil leaves. It was very delicious and makes me want to eat more rice with it.

Last to be served was the Deep Fried Pork Knuckle. The large size of the pork knuckle shocked us a little when it was served. Among all the food we ordered, this was the best dish. The pork knuckle was covered with delicious crackling, which was very easy to eat even for the elders in the group, due to its crispiness. The meat was tender, and I especially enjoyed the tendon of the pork knuckle, the jelly like substance that was both flavour packed and succulent. My gf loved the dish, even though she doesn't normally enjoy eating meat. While it was already great to eat on its own, we also enjoyed the green dipping sauce that came with it, which had a balanced level of spiciness from the chilli and sourness from the lime juice.

For drinks, they offered a choice of bottled drinking water and sugarcane drink in a bottle. We opted for the sugarcane drink, but while it was too sweet for my taste, the sweetness was a great way to balance the spiciness in the food.

Overall, great food, reasonably priced. I would recommend giving this place a try, especially for their pork knuckle.

author: Yuhng Yeap
review_text:
Lovely old and traditional restaurant serving Thai-Chinese fusion cuisine. Its located inside a very well-preserved old heritage building.

We ordered various of their signature dishes and all of them were pretty good, with a few standout dishes. The best dishes were the deep fried pork knuckles and salted fish kailan vege. The pork knuckle is crispy on the outside, and very soft and tender on the inside, the meat literally melts in your mouth. I highly recommend pairing the meat with the sweet soy sauce that comes with it, absolutely delicious! For salted fish kailan lovers, their rendition is very good. The kailan is not too hard, and not bitter at all. Moreover, the salted fish is very fragrant and flavorful. Highly recommend these 2 dishes!

Some other decent dishes include their tomyum, which is super flavourful and spicy, and the thai-style water spinach. Their crab-based dishes are pretty interesting as they use whole crab meats as the ingredients, which includes the cartilage and sometimes crab shells. It's very annoying to pick away the cartilage and randomly bite into a shell while eating the crab fried rice and egg. However, the taste of those dishes are still pretty good.

Dishes we found slightly underwhelming (but still good) are the shrimp rolls and oyster omelette. The shrimp roll tasted pretty bland without much of a shrimp taste. While the oyster omelette is also pretty bland, I very much prefer the Penang style oyster omelette instead unfortunately.

Overall, it's still an incredible restaurant right in the town center and I highly recommend to try it out you love Thai-Chinese fusion food.

author: Neo TH
review_text: My local friend recommended this restaurant, food is delicious, very local style, must come try, need to wait very long when very crowded. All dish is nice can order and try, highly recommended pork knuckle.

author: M C
review_text: A little pricey but food quality is good. Big servings, good for sharing. Plenty of crab meat in fish maw soup and crab tofu. Can get crowded quickly so come earlier. Cash and QR payment only

author: PL Chia
review_text: The fish here was really cheap and affordable. We had steam pompret, oysters and tom yum at such an affordable price!

author: Chong CC
review_text: This is a famous old shop in Hat Yai. Now it seems that many customers are waiting for food! Both Thai hot and sour and Teochew cuisine are very good.

author: Raymond Beh
review_text:
The dishes arrived looks simple, but the taste is quite good. Recommanded to be one of the food stop for anyone visiting hatyai.

Highly recommand to try their fried egg with mince meat, seafood fried rice and braised pork belly.

author: Crayon Lum
review_text:
Located in an happening area, Kim Yong Market. They serve different kinds of Thai food, and it is suitable for a Chinese stomach. Tom yam tastes good but it's a bit salty, the portion of crab meat tofu is quite big, and crab meat is present too. It might take up to 1 hour upon order during peak hours (7-8pm weekends).
The staff and owner are friendly and helpful, they can speak Mandarin.

author: Song Sean Loo
review_text: The food portion was very large although a bit expensive. The food was nice. Most importantly, they served the food at an exceptionally fast speed. There were lots of ants on the side of my table.

author: Kullakaln G.
review_text: Very impressed, each dish has its own unique flavor and texture. The taste is delicate not too strong but just right. Definitely going back to try another menu.

author: Timmy Chan
review_text:
All the food we ordered was really good. Worth the 30 min wait at dinner time.
Pork knuckle was crispy outside n moist inside. Better than many that we had in famous restaurants in Germany.
Fried oyster was very different from those in Malaysia n it's a must try.

author: Andrew Chan (www.roadtrippers.asia)
review_text:
The food is really nice here .. the pork leg was fabulous, and so was the tomyum. The prawn roll is nice, and so was the chicken feet yam. The only item I personally didn't like as much was the crab tofu as my tofu preference is the local tofu rather than the japanese egg tofu.

Service is good, food preparation is fast, and the environment is that of an old kopitiam. This shop, I think, has been around for a good 50 - 80 years. Prices of food are acceptable for food quality and freshness and also location. It was easily walkable from the Lee Garden Plaza..

author: The Guy
review_text:
Last weekend, I had the absolute pleasure of dining at Kaitainam, a Thai restaurant that’s quickly become my new favorite spot. Tucked away in a cozy corner of town, Kaitainam offers an inviting atmosphere with warm lighting, subtle Thai decor, and a soft hum of chatter that makes you feel right at home. From the moment I walked in, the staff greeted me with genuine smiles and a level of hospitality that’s hard to come by these days.

The menu is a delightful journey through Thailand’s culinary landscape, and I started with their papaya salad—som tam—which was a revelation. The balance of spicy, sweet, sour, and salty was spot-on, with fresh green papaya shredded to perfection and a handful of crushed peanuts adding just the right crunch. For my main, I went with the green curry with chicken, and it was nothing short of spectacular. The creamy coconut milk melded beautifully with the fragrant herbs and tender chicken, served alongside a fluffy mound of jasmine rice that soaked up every bit of that rich, aromatic sauce. I couldn’t resist trying their mango sticky rice for dessert, and it was the ultimate finale—sweet, ripe mango paired with sticky rice drizzled in coconut cream that melted in my mouth.

What sets Kaitainam apart is the attention to detail. Every dish felt fresh, vibrant, and made with care, like it was crafted just for me. The service was impeccable—attentive without being overbearing—and the prices were surprisingly reasonable for the quality. Whether you’re a Thai food aficionado or just dipping your toes in, Kaitainam delivers an experience that’s as authentic as it is unforgettable. I’m already counting the days until my next visit!

author: Cher Ong
review_text: Was stunned by the atmosphere. It's huge with a really nice wooden vibe. Service is bad. We were looking at the menu & the crew were standing & waiting without any patience. We were contemplating what to order, but no suggestions were given. It's just 2 of us & we ordered 4 dishes. Staff didn't warn us about the portion. Was shocked when the dishes arrived. It's good for 4 people & above. We wasted a lot of food. Pricing is high, but the portion is big. Food taste average only.

author: Ken Ny
review_text: Order pineapple fries rice, fries shrimp cake, mango salad and hot pot seafood egg. Pineapple fries rice portion is very big. Overall the food is good and atmosphere is super nice. Services for us is average only. The price for the food, a bottle of beer, coconut and plain water cost 1300bath for 6 persons.

author: Sy Tan
review_text: Good environment, good vibes with many spot to take photo. And very good services by the worker. Food variety is good, many choices.  Worth a try, but food taste have room of improvement . Thai tea is good

author: 胡钰婷
review_text:
The experience was very bad.

author: Rohee Lee
review_text: Tomyam and omelette were tasty! The fried fish is soso only. Overall the service is good the waitress patiently explain the dishes in mandarin. Will come back again for other dishes next time ☺️

author: lee sin jean
review_text:

The food is delicious and the price is consider worthy to the portions. There is a little museum beside this restaurant belong to same boss. The boss also come to greet us welcome.

author: Kung Chien Pin
review_text:
Worth Trying -Kaeng Som and Fried Pork Knuckle

Prices are quite affordable, and the food portions are generous! If you're dining with someone who doesn’t typically eat a lot, it's a good idea to keep that in mind and avoid over-ordering. It genuinely took me some time to decide on my order from the menu.

The atmosphere was filled with lovely music from a band until 10PM, but unfortunately, the live performance wrapped up just as I stepped into the restaurant.

author: Sheryn Choong
review_text:
Good food. We had 4 items and cost us thb1200. Service a bit slow but that's probably because it's peak time n a lot of customers.  Server very sweet and apologetic,  but one can see they worked very hard,  serving at full speed as fast as they can.
They also hv a lovely band playing live when we were there on Sat.

author: Alice Ang (艾利斯)
review_text:
Good taste🤭
Is VERY Big portion of the pineapple fried rice😅 i think 6pax also dont even can finish 🤭

author: Edwin Ting
review_text: The waitress here is attentive and can converse in Mandarin fluently. You’ll be spoilt for choice when you see the menu, which includes exotic options like ant eggs. By the way this is a non-halal restaurant.

author: Uachit Petchkong
review_text:
Food is huge portion if come only 1-2 ppl.
If 4-5 ppl it will be great portion.
Found many rare or special menu here.
Food taste Hot n Spicy like authentic southern part of thailand style.
Stuff is really nice service mind.
